stock.description: Rici Healthcare Holdings Limited operates as an investment holding company, managing a variety of healthcare establishments across the People's Republic of China. Its operations encompass general and specialized hospitals, clinics, and medical examination centers. By the close of 2021, specifically December 31st, the company's network included 68 medical examination centers. Beyond these core activities, Rici Healthcare also offers health advisory services, nursing care, diagnostic testing, and leasing arrangements. The firm was established in 2000 and has its principal corporate office located in Shanghai, China.
